title: Trump says he knows more about nuclear weapons than Obama would
description_short: Trump says he knows more about nuclear weapons than Obama would
description_medium: At an April 2, 2016 campaign speech in Eau Claire, Wisconsin, Trump criticized President Obama and said, 'I know more about nuclear weapons and he'll never know.' The current card shifts the remark to 2018 and broadens it to a claim of knowing more than anyone.

title: Trump Amasses Fortune During Presidency
description_medium: Donald Trump has amassed an enormous fortune during his presidency, with ethics experts and Democratic congressmen expressing concern that he is using his presidency to increase his personal wealth to 'unprecedented' levels. Trump earned an 'unprecedented' $2.2 billion in income in his second term as president.

title: Pardons Angela Stanton
description_short: Trump pardoned Angela Stanton, who had been convicted of a conspiracy to transport stolen vehicles.
description_medium: President Trump granted Angela Ronae Stanton a pardon after her conviction in the Northern District of Georgia. The Justice Department list identifies the offense as conspiracy to transport a stolen vehicle across state lines and tampering with a vehicle identification number; it records time served and three years of supervised release, including six months of home confinement. The list does not explain the conduct or clemency rationale.
